name: Linnorm (Draconic Bloodline)
body:
Draconic bloodragers and sorcerers with a linnorm bloodline are most likely descended from someone who survived a linnorm’s Death Curse after killing one of these dragons and managing to bathe their body in its blood.

These heroes tend to spring glorious lineages, but their successors attract bad luck and can have short lives.

Variant Bloodline Arcana: Whenever you cast a spell with the curse descriptor, increase the spell’s save DC by 1.

Drake Type	Energy Type	Breath Shape
Cairn	Acid	30-foot cone
Crag	Fire	60-foot line
Fjord	Cold	60-foot line
Gare	Fire	30-foot cone
Ice	Cold	30-foot cone
Sea	Electricity	60-foot line
Taiga	Electricity	30-foot cone
Tarn	Acid	60-foot line
Tor	Fire	30-foot cone
